'''This''' [[Command ship/Legends|planetary command ship]] was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was part of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]] this command ship took part in and was destroyed during the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] of [[Kalandis Seven]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Planetary command ship was first mentioned in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', which was released on [[October 2]], [[2012]]. The command ship first appears in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'' which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] and released on [[October 23]], 2012.
